name: Distinct member / distinct issuer

request.need: ADR-001 needs an S6: the voucher is not the holder; multi-issuer needs k distinct accredited issuers

dish: A verifier learns that two credentials in one proof come from two distinct members (or issuers), with the duplicate case unsatisfiable rather than merely rejected.
ingredients: two credential leaves/secrets and their paths
pantry: the two nullifiers or issuer ids as constrained public signals

method.clause: leaf_a ≠ leaf_b (or issuer_a ≠ issuer_b) enforced as a non-zero inverse constraint — no witness exists for equality

yield: that the two are distinct — nothing about which two
doesNotEstablish: that the two parties are independent in the accreditation sense (declared, not proven — X8)
distinct natural persons or independent key controllers merely from distinct leaves, keys or issuer identifiers

history.evidence: zkp-tf #18 (talltree 08-26 / Scott 08-27): seed set for the board
